fn_ACTIVATE_details.message: Activates the clickable under the cursor — the same as a left mouse click on that element. Works with links, buttons, and other interactive targets KeyPilot highlights.

fn_ACTIVATE_NEW_TAB_description.message: Open link in a new foreground tab

fn_ACTIVATE_NEW_TAB_details.message: Opens the hovered link in a new tab and switches to it immediately. Use when you want to follow a link without leaving your place permanently, but still jump to the new page right away.

fn_ACTIVATE_NEW_TAB_BACKGROUND_descripti.message: Open link in a new background tab

fn_ACTIVATE_NEW_TAB_BACKGROUND_details.message: Opens the hovered link in a new tab without switching focus — like a middle-click. Useful for queueing several links while you keep reading the current page.

fn_BACK_details.message: Navigates one step back in the current tab’s history, equivalent to the browser Back button.

fn_BACK2_details.message: Navigates one step back in the current tab’s history, equivalent to the browser Back button. Duplicate id for layouts that expose a second Back binding.

fn_FORWARD_details.message: Navigates one step forward in the current tab’s history, equivalent to the browser Forward button.

fn_DELETE_details.message: Toggles Delete Mode: hover elements and remove (hide) them from the page so you can declutter layouts. Exit with Exit Focus or by toggling again.

fn_TAB_LEFT_details.message: Activates the tab to the left of the current one in the window’s tab strip.

fn_TAB_RIGHT_details.message: Activates the tab to the right of the current one in the window’s tab strip.

fn_ROOT_details.message: Jumps to the site root (scheme + host) of the current page — useful for escaping deep paths without typing a URL.

fn_LAUNCHER_details.message: Opens the Launcher popover for jumping to favorite or configured sites without using the omnibox.

fn_TOP_SITES_details.message: Opens Top Sites: a quick list drawn from the toolbar, most-visited pages, and recent bookmarks so you can open a frequent destination in one step.

fn_CLOSE_TAB_details.message: Closes the active tab. Behavior matches the browser’s close-tab action for the current window.

fn_CANCEL_details.message: Cancels the current KeyPilot mode or overlay (Delete Mode, Scroll Line, text focus helpers, and similar) and returns to normal browsing.

fn_PAGE_UP_INSTANT_details.message: Scrolls the current scroll target up by roughly one viewport without animation — faster than a smooth page-up when you need to move quickly.

fn_PAGE_DOWN_INSTANT_details.message: Scrolls the current scroll target down by roughly one viewport without animation — faster than a smooth page-down when you need to move quickly.

fn_PAGE_TOP_description.message: Jump to top of scroll target

fn_PAGE_TOP_details.message: Moves to the top of the current scroll target. Fade mode hides the jump; Scroll mode animates. Configure the motion style in Settings → Scrolling.

fn_PAGE_BOTTOM_description.message: Jump to bottom of scroll target

fn_PAGE_BOTTOM_details.message: Moves to the bottom of the current scroll target. Fade mode hides the jump; Scroll mode animates. Configure the motion style in Settings → Scrolling.

fn_SCROLL_LINE_details.message: Scrolls from a fixed origin: move the mouse away from the on-screen dot to scroll faster in that direction. Optionally enable middle-click on empty page area under Settings → Scrolling.

fn_NEW_TAB_details.message: Opens a new empty tab in the current window, same as the browser’s New Tab command.

fn_OPEN_POPOVER_description.message: Open link in a popup window

fn_OPEN_POPOVER_details.message: Opens the hovered link in a KeyPilot popup window so you can peek or work in a separate chrome without a full new tab.

fn_PREVIEW_LINK_POPOVER_details.message: Opens Link Preview for the hovered URL in a popup window — skim the destination without committing a full navigation in the main tab.

fn_POI_WEBSITE_details.message: When a map place (POI) is under the cursor, opens that place’s website in Link Preview so you can visit the business or location page without leaving the map.

fn_POI_ADDRESS_details.message: When a map place (POI) is under the cursor, copies its street address to the clipboard for pasting into directions, notes, or forms.

fn_OPEN_SETTINGS_POPOVER_details.message: Opens or closes the KeyPilot Settings popover for themes, scrolling, click mode, layouts, and other preferences.

fn_OMNIBOX_details.message: Opens KeyPilot’s omnibox overlay so you can type a URL or search without clicking the browser address bar.

fn_TAB_HISTORY_details.message: Opens Tab History for the current tab so you can jump to a previously visited page in this tab’s session without using the browser’s native history UI.

fn_TOGGLE_KEYBOARD_HELP_description.message: Show or hide the keyboard map

fn_TOGGLE_KEYBOARD_HELP_details.message: Toggles the floating Keyboard Reference window that shows your current layout’s keycaps and bindings.

fn_HIGHLIGHT_description.message: Select text and copy rich text

fn_HIGHLIGHT_details.message: Enters character-level text selection under the cursor. By default, the selection is copied as rich text so formatting is preserved when you paste.

fn_RECTANGLE_HIGHLIGHT_details.message: Selects HTML elements that intersect a dragged rectangle, or pick elements cumulatively. Useful for grabbing structure (not just plain text) from a page region.

fn_COPY_HOVERED_IMAGE_details.message: Copies the image under the cursor to the clipboard, Media Library, or both — configure the destination on the action. Prefer this when you want the image bytes or a saved library entry, not just a URL.

fn_COPY_HOVERED_URL_details.message: Copies the URL under the cursor to the clipboard, Media Library, or both. Use this when you need the href itself rather than fetching or opening the resource.

fn_COPY_HOVERED_VIDEO_details.message: Copies the video under the cursor (file bytes to Media Library when fetchable, or the video URL to the clipboard). No default layout key — bind it in Layout Editor if you need it.

fn_FONT_INFO_details.message: Shows a popover with the font name, size, family, file type, and resource URL for the styled text under the cursor, and outlines that text run. No default layout key — bind it in Layout Editor if you need it.

fn_PAGE_MEDIA_description.message: Browse media found on this page

fn_PAGE_MEDIA_details.message: Opens a gallery of images, videos, documents, fonts, and URLs discovered on the current page so you can review or collect them without hunting through the DOM.

fn_OPEN_MEDIA_LIBRARY_details.message: Opens the Media Library where items you previously copied or saved (images, videos, URLs, and related assets) are kept for reuse.

fn_CLIPBOARD_COPY_details.message: Copies the current text selection to the system clipboard. Prefer this over OS shortcuts when you want Copy available as a KeyPilot layout binding.

fn_CLIPBOARD_CUT_details.message: Cuts the current text selection to the system clipboard from the focused field or editable region.

fn_CLIPBOARD_PASTE_details.message: Pastes clipboard text into the focused text field or editable element. Bind with a modifier chord if you need it while typing.

fn_CLIPBOARD_SELECT_ALL_description.message: Select all in field or page

fn_CLIPBOARD_SELECT_ALL_details.message: Selects all text in the focused field, or the page content when nothing editable is focused — same idea as the usual Select All shortcut.

fn_SELECT_WORD_description.message: Select the word under the cursor

fn_SELECT_WORD_details.message: Selects the word under the KeyPilot cursor. Press again over the same word to deselect it. Exclusive vs cumulative is a popover setting (shared, not per-key). Copy reads this selection.

fn_SELECT_SENTENCE_description.message: Select the sentence under the cursor

fn_SELECT_SENTENCE_details.message: Selects the sentence under the KeyPilot cursor. Press again over the same sentence to deselect it. Exclusive vs cumulative is a popover setting (shared, not per-key).

fn_SELECT_PARAGRAPH_description.message: Select the paragraph under the cursor

fn_SELECT_PARAGRAPH_details.message: Selects the paragraph (or nearest block) under the KeyPilot cursor. Press again over the same block to deselect it. Exclusive vs cumulative is a popover setting (shared, not per-key).

fn_SELECT_IMAGE_description.message: Select the image under the cursor

fn_SELECT_IMAGE_details.message: Selects the image under the KeyPilot cursor. Press again over the same image to deselect it. Exclusive vs cumulative is a popover setting (shared, not per-key). Copy can copy selected images.

fn_LOOKUP_WORD_details.message: Shows a Free Dictionary API definition popover for the word under the cursor. No AI setup required; optionally switch the source to Ask AI on the Action Instance.

fn_SHOW_POPOVER_details.message: Renders the previous Macro Step’s result (or configured fallback text) in a popover. A display primitive — add it as a Macro Step, not as a key action.

fn_param_content_placeholder.message: Fallback text if the previous step produced none…

fn_ADD_URL_TO_MEDIA_LIBRARY_details.message: Stores the hyperlink under the cursor itself (its href) in Media Library — does not download the resource the link points to.

fn_FETCH_URL_FOR_MEDIA_LIBRARY_details.message: Fetches the resource the hyperlink under the cursor points to (for example a .pdf, .mp3, or .mp4) and stores it in Media Library. Images, videos, and documents are classified from the file type. Web pages are not downloaded — use Add URL to Media Library for those.

fn_TYPE_CHARACTERS_description.message: Type saved text into a field

fn_TYPE_CHARACTERS_details.message: Types configured text into the focused field each time the key is pressed. Create multiple Action Instances of this Function — each with its own text — and place them on different keys.

fn_param_text_to_type_placeholder.message: e.g. your email address, a signature, a snippet…

fn_EXECUTE_JS_details.message: Runs a pasted JavaScript snippet in the content-script isolated world with the hovered clickable and other page state. Optional callbacks (popover, clipboard, notify) are injected only when checked on the Action Instance.

fn_GET_TEXT_AT_CURSOR_details.message: Reads the word, sentence, paragraph, or hyperlink under the cursor (choose granularity on the Action Instance) and copies it to the clipboard.

fn_GET_TEXT_RANGE_description.message: Pass selection to the next Macro Step

fn_GET_TEXT_RANGE_details.message: Reads the current highlight/selection into the next Macro Step. A data primitive — add it as a Macro Step, not as a key action (use Copy for that).

fn_GET_MEDIA_AT_CURSOR_details.message: Reads the image, video, or audio under the cursor (choose kind on the Action Instance) and copies it — or its URL — to the clipboard.

fn_TRANSLATE_details.message: Translates the highlighted text, or the word/sentence/paragraph under the cursor when nothing is highlighted. Configure target language and whether the result replaces page text or opens in a popover.

fn_param_config.description: Function parameter label for a Macro Key configuration.

fn_COLS_TOGGLE_details.message: Columnizes the element under the cursor into a multi-column layout so dense text or lists are easier to scan. Toggle again to restore the original layout.

fn_SEND_TEXT_TO_AI_details.message: Sends the selected text to AI with a configurable instruction, then routes the result to the clipboard and/or a popover. Configure the prompt and destination on the action instance.
